description: Source code for internal implementation of absl::container::internal::raw_hash_set, including functions for managing hash table control bytes, rehashing, and deletion handling.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a group of control bytes in the hash table, with methods for converting control byte states.

methods.name: RandomSeed
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random seed based on thread-local or atomic counter.

methods.name: DropDeletesWithoutResize
methods.description: Rehashes the table by removing deleted entries and reorganizing.

methods.name: EraseMetaOnly
methods.description: Erases an element at a given iterator position, updating control bytes.

methods.name: ConvertDeletedToEmptyAndFullToDeleted
methods.description: Converts deleted control bytes to empty and full control bytes to deleted.

methods.name: find_first_non_full_outofline
methods.description: Finds the first non-full slot for a given hash outside inline functions.
